metadata.source_filename: Energy Drink Consumption Information (Responses) - Form Responses 1.csv
metadata.method: balanced respondent bootstrap with uniform within-reported-range sampling; flagged conditional hot-deck frequency imputation
metadata.privacy: No timestamps, names, raw open responses, or demographic guesses exported. Template IDs retain internal source row order; this is not a privacy guarantee.
limitations: This is an expansion of a convenience survey, not a representative market population.
Agents share templates and are not independent respondents.
No calibrated causal elasticity, product utility, adoption model, or predictive accuracy is established.
One stated +25% response does not identify a full demand curve.
Brand mentions are not inferred market shares. Unresolved shares remain null.
Currency remains unconverted; bare values have UNKNOWN currency.

data_dictionary.population_weight: 1/1000; use for the literal generated population.
data_dictionary.template_weight: 1/(79 * replicas_of_template); use for summaries giving each original respondent exactly equal weight.
data_dictionary.weekly_rate: Expected drinks/week, not an integer weekly purchase count; annualized when explicit. Uniform draw for a stated range is a modeling assumption, not measured uncertainty.
data_dictionary.reported_weekly_interval: Source interpretation before imputation. null means source frequency unresolved.
data_dictionary.frequency_donor_template_id: Only populated for frequency imputation; other preferences remain those of the original template.
data_dictionary.brand_shares: Explicit interpretable proportions only; null does not mean zero. Java Monster is kept as a product-line bucket separate from other Monster.
data_dictionary.brands_purchased: Brands recognized in current-purchase answer; not inferred from favorite-product answer. Mentioning a sole brand does not automatically imply 100% share.
data_dictionary.sugar_preference: Broad coded preference; both_or_conditional includes exceptions. No individual-product ingredient inference.
data_dictionary.usual_price_per_drink: Draw from interpretable stated per-drink range; null when unsafe to parse. No currency conversion.
data_dictionary.max_price_per_drink: Stated consideration threshold, not a hard purchase cutoff. null when unclear.
data_dictionary.price_up_25pct_action: Qualitative code for the single stated +25% scenario. switch includes tentative consideration, not certainty of switching.
data_dictionary.promotion_response: Broad qualitative code; responsive_or_conditional does not quantify volume uplift.
data_dictionary.simulation_seed: Reproducible independent random stream seed for downstream simulated events; does not imply new empirical evidence.
data_dictionary.simulation_eligibility: inactive agents have rate 0; excluded_category is Gatorade-only; imputed agents require sensitivity analysis.
data_dictionary.quality_flags: Review before currency-specific, season-specific, price, or market-share analyses.

metadata.source_snapshot_note: Hash refers to the CSV text snapshot read for analysis; newline normalization may differ from the original upload bytes.
